text:
maya: Quick thread — need a call on sequencing Dedicated vs Private for Q2 roadmap. Customers + sales are pressing.
eli: Agree we need a pragmatic prioritization. My gut: Dedicated unblocks most revenue quickly.
maya: Can we run RICE-ish scores? Short table to compare.
eli: ```
Feature    Reach  Impact  Confidence  Effort  RICE_score
Dedicated  60     3       0.8         2       72
Private    10     5       0.6         5       12
```
tara: Ops note — Private adds VPC networking, KMS integration, audit ingestion, on-prem packaging. Effort multiplier x2-3 vs Dedicated.
sam: Sales push: one named enterprise (RegulatedBank) says "we'll sign if Private on prem + HSM in 6 months" — potential $1.1M ACV. But there are 12 other customers asking for Dedicated capacity guarantees.
maya: So tradeoff is single large deal vs many mid-market deals and general SLO improvements. We should be explicit about launch criteria for each.
eli: Proposal: two-phase sequencing — ship Dedicated first (Q2), then Private (Q3) with shared runtime abstractions so Private dev is mostly integration.
oz: Security gating list for Private: KMS/HSM support, customer key rotation docs, audit log pipeline, compliance checklist (SOC2 controls mapping).
maya: Concrete launch criteria (Dedicated):
- Throughput: sustain 5k tok/s on pool with <2% tail queuing.
- Latency SLO: 95th < 200ms for typical gen workloads.
- Cost: unit cost <= target by using batching + KV cache suggestions.
- Observability: per-customer cost & tracing in Console.
eli: Concrete gating for Private:
1) Implement VPC peering and network ACLs.
2) KMS-backed key management + HSM option.
3) Installer for on-prem + testbed validated.
4) Rollout playbook + rollback.
maya: If we do Dedicated first, we should instrument the Dedicated rollout to validate the abstractions Private will reuse (config flags, auth flows, network plumbing).
eli: Example config we should standardize now: `deployment.mode: "dedicated" | "private"` and `auth.backend: "redwood" | "customer_kms"` so later work is wiring not refactor.
product-bot: Notion doc created: https://notion.redwood/s/prod/dedicated-vs-private-rice (owner: maya)
maya: OK — decision proposal for PM sync:
- Prioritize Dedicated for immediate Q2 launch (high reach, low effort).
- Parallelize core infra pieces needed for Private but keep Private scope limited to integrations in Q3.
- Use RICE doc and sales signals to re-evaluate if a specific customer deal makes Private earlier.
tara: I'll estimate infra stories and post in the ticket with rough T-shirt sizes by EOD.
sam: I'll get the RegulatedBank timeline & term conditions and share in thread.
oz: I'll draft the security checklist and owners.
eli: I'll create a small tech-spike to validate reuse of runtime hooks for network and KMS; 2-sprint effort.
maya: Action items captured. If no objections by EOD I'll update the roadmap. :thumbsup:
sam: +1
eli: +1
tara: +1
oz: +1
maya: thanks all — closing for now.
